title: CommunityContribution
description: A cluster of code-graph symbols detected by a community-detection algorithm (Leiden by default). Universal envelope (Pattern-C, SKILL §8bis Rule 2) so multiple algorithms (leidenalg, louvain, label-propagation, future custom heuristics) can co-exist on the same slot. Communities are a primary input signal to `GsmIdentificationKS` and `GranularityKS` for proposing GSM Application/Component boundaries.

id.description: Stable client-defined identity within (panel, slot). Suggested form: '<algorithm>:<runId>:<communityIndex>' (e.g. 'leiden:run-42:0007'). Used as the contribution identityKey.

algorithm.description: Producer label (analogue of SCIP `SymbolInformation.kind`). Open enum.

members.description: SCIP-style symbol monikers of cluster members. Each entry SHOULD resolve to a contribution in `Index.ScipSymbol` (or, for non-SCIP languages, in `CodeGraph.SymbolRef`) of the same Blackboard.

modularityScore.description: Algorithm-specific quality score (e.g. Leiden modularity in [-0.5, 1.0]). Optional.

label.description: Human-friendly label for diagnostics (e.g. dominant package prefix). Not an identity field.

cacheKey.description: Determinism marker (SKILL §7b.5) for non-deterministic algorithms: SHOULD encode (algorithm version, RNG seed, repo HEAD SHA, input edge-set hash). Required when `algorithm` is non-deterministic (leidenalg, louvain).

nativeAttributes.description: Free-form escape hatch for algorithm-specific attributes (e.g. resolution parameter, beta, n_iterations). Tool-agnostic consumers ignore.
